posts.text: Well, a couple points. First, the fact that any cashiers are millionaires is a data point for why capitalism is better than the alternative. Second, if you measure things in terms of what is available to people materially, a great many of today’s cashiers are millionaires compared to, say, cashiers in 1900.
posts.summary: Defends capitalism as superior system enabling wealth mobility
